purpose: Documents whose speaker-unassigned passages may be associated with one person at query time (--attribution author). Every returned passage carries basis and caution. Corpus labels are never rewritten.

review_notes.scope: Only documents a user's own library can contain with the reviewed bytes. Each key is d_ + sha256(url)[:20], the id library.py fetch assigns when the metadata gives this url and no custom id; on 2026-10-16 each url was fetched again and its SHA256 matched raw_sha256. Collector-built documents need no entries: shareholder letters, CNBC meeting transcripts and the Stripe talks label every personal passage at chunk level, and their unlabelled passages (company reports, stage directions, editorial material, page 1 of the 2014 letter) are deliberately left unattributed. Entries for hand-staged or private batches were removed because no public procedure reproduces their document ids; after importing such material yourself, run attribution.py propose and review each document before adding it here.
review_notes.meeting-notes-principal: Whitney Tilson's notes on the 2005 Wesco annual meeting: Munger chaired the meeting; the notes are third-party paraphrase and interleave questions and note-taker remarks.
review_notes.archive-attributed: 1984 draft op-ed and 2010 'Basically, It's Over': the Worldly Munger archive attributes them to Munger; the copies carry no byline.
review_notes.excluded: Blue Chip Stamps letters (co-signed), 1965-1969 Chace letters, biographies, Singleton 2022 (unattributed two-person dialogue), CNBC meeting unlabelled passages, 2014 mixed letter.
